content.text: Ep.1 QueryPie Integrations: Hitting the Core of Automation!—SCIM, Yap! Vault, Yap! Slack Approval Workflow Integration, Yap!

Companies in finance, commerce, and platform sectors hold various sensitive information across thousands or tens of thousands of databases. Naturally, the security architecture managing these becomes complex due to the clouds, data warehouses, and various BI tools they use. QueryPie's DB Access Control (QueryPie DAC) plays a central role in strengthening security for accumulated sensitive information and enabling convenient access control and management to ensure security stability. We explored methods for reliably managing vast amounts of sensitive information and data in a multi-cloud environment.
How to easily manage access control in multi-cloud environments and various database usage environments
DB Access Control in complex environments such as MongoDB and Hadoop
Easy management and control of sensitive information that is difficult to manage (Schema-free) in NoSQL
Maximize the stability of DB access control management with 'QueryPie DAC'. Check out detailed usage in [Ch. QueryPie: 3-Step Side Kick]!
